LanguageData.VFEI_HunterDesc: Hunter insectoids proactively search for and hunt wildlife near their hive, bringing back and storing kills for communal consumption.
LanguageData.VFEI_InfestationHasSpreadDesc: The insectoid hive has spread. The quest {0} has ended.
LanguageData.VFEI_InfestationTooltip:
Whether this tile is under the effects of an insectoid infestation.
Areas around insectoid hives are often teeming with insects, with various insect-built structures affecting the environment. Infestations are much more likely to occur, and travelling parties may find roaming insectoids.
LanguageData.VFEI_LetterInsectWaveSummoned: Attracted by your thumper vibrations, an insectoid leader from {0} will emerge from the ground soon. Be prepared.
LanguageData.VFEI_NotForPlayers: This Patriarch is under player control and therefore has no connection to a wild hive

LanguageData.VFEI_SettleWarning: This tile is near an insectoid hive, so there will be an ever-present insectoid influence on it. Infestations will happen every {0} days. Large infestations are much more likely to happen, and may occur anywhere, not just in dark areas. Megaspiders, spelopedes and megascarabs are roaming free, and travelling caravans may have to fend off insectoid swarms.

LanguageData.VFEI_WorkerDesc: Worker insectoids are tasked with constructing and maintaining insectoid-specific structures, as well as performing essential hauling and mining duties.
